title: A clearer checkout for a growing retailer
summary: We simplified a crowded purchase flow into a fast, accessible checkout that works across devices.
challenge: Customers were abandoning checkout after encountering unclear delivery choices, late validation, and a mobile layout that shifted as totals updated.
solution: The flow was rebuilt around stable responsive regions, inline validation, explicit delivery states, and reusable form primitives shared with the account area.
outcome: The new experience reduced hesitation and gave the internal team a maintainable component model for future checkout experiments.

title: A dependable operations dashboard foundation
summary: A reusable information system helped an operations team scan, filter, and act on live work more quickly.
challenge: Critical status information was spread across dense screens with inconsistent controls, making repeated daily work slower and more error-prone.
solution: We defined semantic status tokens, predictable table actions, reusable empty and loading states, and a responsive navigation pattern optimized for repeated use.
outcome: Teams gained a coherent interface vocabulary, while engineers could build new operational views from tested primitives instead of starting over.
